summary: The exact fixture authorization and byte-level task gate preserve scope, but the new harness regression tests fail after the authorized downstream fixture repair. One BLOCKER prevents merge recommendation.

findings.title: Bind fixture-scope test inputs to an immutable baseline
findings.description: BEFORE reads the current working-tree transaction fixture. Once KL-024 applies the only authorized 2026-09-27 to 2026-09-28 literal repair, BEFORE no longer contains OLD, so test_only_proposed_literal_change_is_authorized fails with 0 != 1 and the other negative-oracle tests mostly return baseline-unexpected instead of their asserted content-scope error. CI runs kl test-harness on every PR, so the governance authorization creates a new blocker for precisely the downstream change it is intended to enable. KL-024 cannot repair these harness tests within its declared scope.
findings.reproduction: In a temporary isolated copy of the validator, fixture-scope test and database fixture, change only the authorized UPDATE date literal. Run python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short tests/harness/test_planning_fixture_scope.py::test_only_proposed_literal_change_is_authorized: 1 failed, exit 1. A broader selection covering the authorization, negative-oracle, unexpected-base and committed-byte tests produced 8 failed, 1 passed, 3 deselected. No repository fixture or implementation was modified.
findings.requested_change: Use a stable protected-base fixture input for these regression tests and verify that they still pass when the current fixture contains the authorized repaired literal. Preserve the meaningful oracle-drift, skip, unrelated-byte and wrong-date rejection cases.

It passed protected Frozen/product/migration/database-test/completed/requirement/integration immutability, exact KL-024-only metadata projection and source-SHA byte equality for the copied BLOCKED result, failure, migration and proposal.
Verified all indexed and manifest checksums and byte counts, all check-log tested_commit and exit_code 0 bindings, and the unchanged GENERAL/PROTOCOL/DB_CONCURRENCY base/head review union.

Inspected the actual S27 active-partition uniqueness collision and the unchanged head-day GuardRequired assertion/restoration and successful atomic completion in the source fixture. The proposed repair uses a free date and preserves the mismatch oracle; HG-032 changes no fixture or product path.

Reviewed the new guard implementation and negative tests. It reads committed protected-base/head bytes and permits exactly the one literal change while rejecting wrong dates, weakened oracles, test skipping, unrelated content and other wave-task ownership. Committed raw evidence reports 49 focused, 228 harness and 202 unit tests passing before the downstream repair, plus successful harness validation, lint and typecheck.
Reproduced the downstream fixture-test failure in an isolated temporary copy, without altering repository implementation or running database suites.
